input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Our convenience exit is already acceptable: Section 14 (p0079) lets Client terminate on written notice with services ending the last day of the month following the notice month (roughly 30–60 days), and no early-termination fee, penalty or unamortised charge appears anywhere (fees are invoiced monthly in arrears under Section 5, p0045). That meets or betters fallback elements 1 and 2; the preferred extras (a flat 30-day notice and an express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees) are short but immaterial here because nothing is prepaid, so we note rather than flag them. The material failure is on the Vendor side: Section 13 (p0078) auto-renews for successive one-year terms but lets TrueLink block renewal on only thirty (30) days' notice. A Vendor convenience exit on fewer than 90 days' notice is walk-away territory for us and gives no realistic window to migrate hosting, interface and credit-data services. Our redline keeps TrueLink's exit confined to the end of a term and raises its notice to ninety (90) days, while leaving Client's 30-day non-renewal notice and Section 14 termination right untouched; the change sits at the fallback level.

proposal.summary: Extend TrueLink's end-of-term non-renewal notice to 90 days while preserving Client's 30-day notice.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our position is that the Vendor may exit only at the end of a term and on at least 90 days' notice; a 30-day non-renewal notice from TrueLink leaves us too little time to migrate hosting and credit-data services. We have left our own 30-day non-renewal notice and our Section 14 termination right untouched.

ops.oldText: unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year
ops.newText: unless Client delivers to TrueLink written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days, or TrueLink delivers such notice no later than ninety (90) days, prior to the end of said year

mappings.element: Customer may terminate for convenience on 60 to 90 days' notice.
mappings.quote: TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.

mappings.element: Any early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
mappings.quote: TrueLink will provide Client with an invoice for the requested Hosting Services and Support Services and any other agreed-upon services on a monthly basis. Invoices will be paid within 15 days of receipt.
